title: Entry: one family, built and tuned for one configuration
description: An entry is a configuration-keyed record. `target` is the configuration it was BUILT and TUNED for; `compat` states the facts about where it is valid, not a policy about where it should be used. Choosing between entries is the consuming product's job; nothing in this repo does it.

id.description: Directory name under families/<family>/entries/. Conventionally <backend>-<gpu chip slug>-<os><major>-<browser><major>, which is a readable summary of `target`, not a key anything parses.

variant.description: "exact" when the graphs compute the model as written. Anything else names an approximation that changes the output, e.g. "todo2-nearest". A consumer that cares about fidelity filters on this.

created.description: ISO 8601 date the entry was added.

workbench.description: <repo>@<commit> of the harness that emitted and measured the graphs.

recorder.description: The recorder that dumped the recipes.

target.description: The configuration this entry was built and tuned for, as scripts/probe-target.mjs observed it on the producing machine.

compat.description: Facts, not policy. `requires` is what must be true for these graphs to build and compute correctly; everything else in `target` is where they were tuned and timed, which is a different claim.

requires.description: Dotted paths into a target object, each with the value that must match exactly. Kept deliberately small: a key here is a claim that the entry does not work without it.

ops.description: The MLGraphBuilder methods the recipes call. A browser missing one of these cannot build the graphs, whatever else matches.

graphs.description: The graphs this entry carries, plus how they chain. Every key except `chain` is a graph name.

chain.description: On-device links: ["<graph>.<output>", "<graph>.<input>"]. One MLTensor is the producer's output AND the consumer's input, so the value never crosses into JS. Empty when the entry has one graph.

recipe.description: Path, relative to the entry directory, of a file matching schema/recipe.schema.json.

constants.description: Key into manifest.json's `constants` naming the blob this graph's byteOffsets index.

provenance.description: Path to the ledger: what was folded, what was rejected and by which number, what the backend turned out to be like.

tokenizerFromFamily.description: True when the family's tokenizer is what turns a prompt into this entry's graph inputs.

readable.description: Output only: whether a consumer is expected to read it back. Every declared output must still be BOUND at dispatch.
